headline: Redesigned Android widgets and a more flexible widget editor.
highlights: Choose Paper / Pulse or Mono / Signal, with distinct assignment, schedule, setlist, announcement, pending-response, and shortcut layouts.
Customize with a live preview, expanded preview, size comparisons, spacing, text, accent colors, artwork, and content options.
The widget editor follows your phone's light or dark mode; each widget can use its own theme.
Orange date tiles now use white lettering. Existing widget navigation, paging, account protection, and optional transitions are preserved.
